Angry Catfish Thursday FTW Social Ride

Minneapolis, MN · Standish / Hiawatha · Social · Road

Angry Catfish Thursday FTW Social Ride is a social and road group ride in Minneapolis, MN. It rolls every Thursday at 6:30 pm from Angry Catfish Bicycle + Coffee Bar. About 15 miles, social pace, 10–15 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @angrycatfish the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Angry Catfish Thursday FTW Social Ride group ride

A weekly ride for femme, trans and women riders only. About 15 miles at a talking pace, route varies. Starts and ends at the shop's coffee bar. Ride details go out on the shop's Discord and Instagram.
